subject.title: fix: stabilize OpenClaw beta setup and PT-PT formatting

question: Should the Companion make `2026.7.2-beta.3` its default before the upstream wizard-runtime correction is merged and released in an official artifact?
rationale: The branch’s implementation quality cannot decide whether the project should expose new users to a prerelease whose supported setup path is still blocked by a separate repository’s unshipped fix.

options.title: Defer the beta default
options.body: Keep or restore a setup-proven official default and carry beta support only after an official artifact passes the real Companion setup path.

options.title: Approve the beta policy explicitly
options.body: Accept the prerelease default only with explicit maintainer ownership of the known setup limitation and a documented recovery/support plan.

recommendation.title: Defer the beta default
recommendation.body: Keep or restore a setup-proven official default and carry beta support only after an official artifact passes the real Companion setup path.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed adjacent current-history contributor available from the review materials; ownership of the broader setup release policy remains uncertain.
